mechanism: register_source() is dead API — defined, exported, never called. symbolic_sources/ is a live corpus directory with 6 doctrine-class files (Yi Jing, LNSA, kundalini, EMOWUL, etc.) but the retrieval engine has no record of it. Because SOURCES and SOURCE_WEIGHT are separate parallel dicts with no coupling, the moment any code calls register_source(KnowledgeSource(id='symbolic_sources', ...)), the corpus enters SOURCES but SOURCE_WEIGHT falls back to 1.0 — silently the highest-ranked corpus. Dead API + documented future corpus = pre-activation trap.
hypothesis: If weight field is added to KnowledgeSource (mandatory, no default) and engine.py derives source_w from SOURCES[id].weight instead of SOURCE_WEIGHT dict, then register_source() without explicit weight becomes a TypeError — the silent promotion path is closed before symbolic_sources is ever wired in.

This makes weight a first-class corpus property.
